arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
arcane_bolt.desc: A bolt of raw arcane force.

frost_lance.name: Frost Lance
frost_lance.desc: A spear of ice that numbs as it strikes.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.desc: A crack of force that knocks the breath out of everyone nearby.

chain_spark.name: Chain Spark
chain_spark.desc: Lightning that leaps to a second target.

ice_storm.name: Ice Storm
ice_storm.desc: Hail and frost over a wide circle.

meteor_fall.name: Meteor Fall
meteor_fall.desc: Calls burning stone down from the sky.

starfire_lance.name: Starfire Lance
starfire_lance.desc: Pure arcane force, enough to punch through a wall.

ward.name: Ward
ward.desc: A shimmering shield around an ally.

dispel.name: Dispel
dispel.desc: Strips hostile magic and ailments from an ally.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.desc: Turns aside spells and blows alike.

null_field.name: Null Field
null_field.desc: A circle where no spell can be cast.

banishing_word.name: Banishing Word
banishing_word.desc: A word that tears at anything that doesn't belong.

unmaking.name: Unmaking
unmaking.desc: Unpicks the target's own magic and leaves them reeling.

summon_familiar.name: Summon Familiar
summon_familiar.desc: A small spirit-beast that fights at your side.

grasping_mist.name: Grasping Mist
grasping_mist.desc: A clinging fog that holds feet in place.

summon_hound.name: Summon Hound
summon_hound.desc: A spectral hound with real teeth.

blink_strike.name: Blink Strike
blink_strike.desc: Step through nothing and strike from behind.

summon_meltwater_spirit.name: Summon Meltwater Spirit
summon_meltwater_spirit.desc: A spirit from the thawing rivers.

grasping_deep.name: Grasping Deep
grasping_deep.desc: Black hands from below drag at everything.

detect_magic.name: Detect Magic
detect_magic.desc: Shows enchanted items and magic nearby.

identify.name: Identify
identify.desc: Learn what an unknown item really is.

true_strike.name: True Strike
true_strike.desc: Shows an ally exactly where to strike.

third_eye.name: Third Eye
third_eye.desc: You see a little of what's coming.

expose_weakness.name: Expose Weakness
expose_weakness.desc: Shows everyone where the target is weakest.

scry.name: Scry
scry.desc: Reveals hidden sites and enemies in the area.

precognition.name: Precognition
precognition.desc: You already know where the blow will land.

fate_thread.name: Fate Thread
fate_thread.desc: The whole party sees the next few seconds.

doom_sight.name: Doom Sight
doom_sight.desc: Shows every enemy's death, and their weak points.

daze.name: Daze
daze.desc: Scrambles the target's thoughts for a moment.

charm.name: Charm
charm.desc: Makes an enemy reluctant to hurt you.

slumber.name: Slumber
slumber.desc: Puts a group to sleep, briefly.

sap_will.name: Sap Will
sap_will.desc: Drains the target's will to fight.

dominate.name: Dominate
dominate.desc: Takes the fight out of an enemy entirely.

psychic_scream.name: Psychic Scream
psychic_scream.desc: A shriek inside every skull nearby.

phantom_blade.name: Phantom Blade
phantom_blade.desc: A blade that isn't there, and still cuts.

mirror_images.name: Mirror Images
mirror_images.desc: Copies of you take the blows.

veil_the_party.name: Veil the Party
veil_the_party.desc: The whole party fades from sight.

phantasmal_terror.name: Phantasmal Terror
phantasmal_terror.desc: Shows the target what it fears most.

waking_nightmare.name: Waking Nightmare
waking_nightmare.desc: The target can't stop seeing it.

grand_mirage.name: Grand Mirage
grand_mirage.desc: Replaces the whole battlefield with a lie.

life_leech.name: Life Leech
life_leech.desc: Steals a little life to mend your own.

raise_bones.name: Raise Bones
raise_bones.desc: A skeleton claws its way up to serve.

wither.name: Wither
wither.desc: Saps the strength of everyone nearby.

raise_ghoul.name: Raise Ghoul
raise_ghoul.desc: A hungry dead thing that obeys, mostly.

barrow_legion.name: Barrow Legion
barrow_legion.desc: Calls the old dead out of the barrows.

ox_strength.name: Ox Strength
ox_strength.desc: The strength of a draught ox.

slow.name: Slow
slow.desc: Thickens the air around the enemy.

stone_grip.name: Stone Grip
stone_grip.desc: Turns the target's limbs briefly to stone.

rust_touch.name: Rust Touch
rust_touch.desc: Corrodes metal at a touch. Machines hate it.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.desc: Makes everything nearby brittle, then breaks it.

mend_wounds.name: Mend Wounds
mend_wounds.desc: A short prayer that closes wounds.

lantern_light.name: Lantern Light
lantern_light.desc: A warm light that the dead avoid.

renewal.name: Renewal
renewal.desc: Wounds keep closing for a while.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.desc: Roots and creepers grab at feet.

blight.name: Blight
blight.desc: Withers the living like a failed crop.

greenwake.name: Greenwake
greenwake.desc: Spring comes to the whole party.

battle_hymn.name: Battle Hymn
battle_hymn.desc: A hymn the whole party fights to.

holy_brand.name: Holy Brand
holy_brand.desc: Burns the Oath's mark into an enemy.

toll_the_dead.name: Toll the Dead
toll_the_dead.desc: A bell only the target hears.

turn_the_dead.name: Turn the Dead
turn_the_dead.desc: The dead remember they should be resting.

last_rites.name: Last Rites
last_rites.desc: Pulls the dying back from the edge.

ferrymans_toll.name: Ferryman's Toll
ferrymans_toll.desc: The Ferryman takes his fee from your enemy.

pale_lantern.name: Pale Lantern
pale_lantern.desc: A cold light that burns the unquiet.

final_rest.name: Final Rest
final_rest.desc: Sends the target to the Ferryman.

death_ward.name: Death Ward
death_ward.desc: Once per fight, a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP.

call_lightning.name: Call Lightning
call_lightning.desc: A bolt from a clear sky.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.desc: The wind at an ally's back.

squall.name: Squall
squall.desc: Rain so hard nobody can see.

whispered_doubt.name: Whispered Doubt
whispered_doubt.desc: A voice in the ear: you're going to lose.

smugglers_prayer.name: Smuggler's Prayer
smugglers_prayer.desc: Locks and pockets open more easily.

gamblers_grace.name: Gambler's Grace
gamblers_grace.desc: You're never quite where they aimed.

mass_confusion.name: Mass Confusion
mass_confusion.desc: Nobody is sure whose side they're on.

sisters_kiss.name: Sister's Kiss
sisters_kiss.desc: Takes something the target won't miss until later.

piercing_round.name: Piercing Round
piercing_round.desc: A hardened round that punches through armour.

scald_jet.name: Scald Jet
scald_jet.desc: A jet of boiling steam from a hand pump.

pressure_gauge.name: Pressure Gauge
pressure_gauge.desc: You watch the needle. Devices misfire 2% less.

boiler_vent.name: Boiler Vent
boiler_vent.desc: Dumps a boiler's worth of steam.

furnace_heart.name: Furnace Heart
furnace_heart.desc: A pocket boiler that never goes out.

piston_hammerblow.name: Piston Hammerblow
piston_hammerblow.desc: Everything the boiler has, in one blow.

spark_gap.name: Spark Gap
spark_gap.desc: A crackling arc from a hand coil.

static_coat.name: Static Coat
static_coat.desc: A charged field that pushes blows aside.

galvanic_stimulus.name: Galvanic Stimulus
galvanic_stimulus.desc: A jolt that restarts the heart, or the engine.

capacitor_bank.name: Capacitor Bank
capacitor_bank.desc: Stored charge for when you need it.

overload.name: Overload
overload.desc: Dumps the whole cell at once.

rangefinder.name: Rangefinder
rangefinder.desc: You know exactly how far it is.

mark_target.name: Mark Target
mark_target.desc: A mirror flash shows everyone where to shoot.

assay_lens.name: Assay Lens
assay_lens.desc: Reads an item's properties through the lens. Can miss curses.

heliograph_burn.name: Heliograph Burn
heliograph_burn.desc: Focused sunlight, or lamp light, through a great lens.

prism_cannon.name: Prism Cannon
prism_cannon.desc: A beam of focused light that cuts steel.

total_clarity.name: Total Clarity
total_clarity.desc: The whole party sees through your lenses.

dynamite_bundle.name: Dynamite Bundle
dynamite_bundle.desc: Three sticks and a short fuse.

shrapnel_charge.name: Shrapnel Charge
shrapnel_charge.desc: Nails and bolts packed round the charge.

clockwork_beetle.name: Clockwork Beetle
clockwork_beetle.desc: A wind-up beetle with a nasty bite.

field_repair.name: Field Repair
field_repair.desc: Patches up a Wrought or automaton.

spring_turret.name: Spring Turret
spring_turret.desc: A clockwork crossbow on a tripod.

overclock.name: Overclock
overclock.desc: Pushes a machine (or a person) past spec.

iron_bulwark.name: Iron Bulwark
iron_bulwark.desc: A walking wall of riveted iron.

steam_colossus.name: Steam Colossus
steam_colossus.desc: A war engine twice your height.

ossuan_override.name: Ossuan Override
ossuan_override.desc: Old command codes that some machines still obey.

vital_strike.name: Vital Strike
vital_strike.desc: Finds the gap in the armour.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.desc: Breaks their guard, and their armour.

earthshaker.name: Earthshaker
earthshaker.desc: Hits the ground hard enough to floor everyone.

pinning_shot.name: Pinning Shot
pinning_shot.desc: Pins a foot or a sleeve.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.desc: Shake it off and keep going.

dance_of_blades.name: Dance of Blades
dance_of_blades.desc: Through the whole crowd and out the other side.

throat_strike.name: Throat Strike
throat_strike.desc: No more spells, no more shouting.

shout_down.name: Shout Down
shout_down.desc: A bellow that rattles the enemy.

field_orders.name: Field Orders
field_orders.desc: Tells an ally exactly where to go.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.desc: Clean linen and a steady hand.

snare.name: Snare
snare.desc: A quick noose in the grass.
